build_replay_table_from_info: build a reverb replay table from a TableInfo object with sampler, remover, and rate limiter specs
create_selector_from_distribution: create an item selector like FIFO, uniform, prioritized, heap, or LIFO from key distribution options
create_rate_limiter: create a SampleToInsertRatio rate limiter from rate limiter info with samples per insert and min size
convert_replay_sample_to_transition: convert a reverb replay sample to an SARs transition with optional sequence stripping and batch flattening
convert_transition_to_replaysample: convert a types.Transition object into a reverb.ReplaySample with matching sample info dtypes
